evidence.title: STT GDC backs out of planned Vietnam data center project
Evolution DC secures long-term lease for land in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

summary: STT GDC announced it is withdrawing from its planned data center project in Vietnam. Seizing the opportunity, Evolution DC has signed a long‑term lease for land in Ho Chi Minh City to develop a new data center facility.
title: Evolution DC Secures Ho Chi Minh City Land Following STT GDC's Exit from Vietnam Data Center Plan
